svg.text: Logo sheet · concepts and masters · 20 Aug 2026
Six concept directions, two selected masters.
Vectorised from the original brush artwork.
Six directions drawn from the Figma colour roles. Not final. Kept for reference and campaign use.
dark labels only; never a white label
These are the Backwill logo. Everything above is reference only. The pair is one colour swap apart, so they hold identical contrast at 6.04:1.
Light mark on the action-primary ground. Default for dark surfaces, app icons and avatars.
The colour inversion. Dark mark, light ground. Default for documents, light web pages and print.
True pixel size. Full mark at 128px and above; the B alone below, where the trail would break up.
True pixel size. Full mark at 128px and above; the B alone below, where the trail would break up.
The masters use action-primary and text-on-primary only. Sampled from the Figma system, not inferred.
Wordmark is set in Coustard, per the Figma system. Lockups are held separately in logo/svg/.
